purpose: Second fresh independent updated-skill repeat versus historical original; first repeat remains separate.

workflows.repeat: updated skill selects workflow; same numerical acceptance requirements

loc_rules.primary: Physical lines including blank/comments in retained executable support files: wrappers, hooks, tooling; model and substantive numerical tests separate.
loc_rules.secondary: Support self-tests separately; config/schema/docs/generated evidence separately; no hiding saved replay/report helper scripts.
loc_rules.transient: Tool orchestration not retained as project source and external comparison harness excluded from project LOC but disclosed.
loc_rules.versions: Freeze file hashes at delivered repeat before comparison or any parent repair.
loc_rules.embedded: Evidence-only capture code embedded inside a substantive test file must be disclosed and counted as support, not hidden by its filename. Retain both file-based inventory and explicit AST line-span adjustment where applicable.

detection_rules.healthy: Both suites must pass shared healthy model before a mutation result counts.
detection_rules.faults: Same six predetermined fault classes plus two separately labelled reintroductions of historical floating-point defects.
detection_rules.kill: A relevant behavioural assertion failure, not collection/import/setup failure, timeout or syntax error.
detection_rules.freeze: Repeat agent cannot inspect shared candidate variants or original tests before its suite is frozen.

limits: One additional authoring repeat; two updated-skill repeats now exist, not randomized or matched old/new authoring conditions.
Different authoring agents/model and evolving guidance confound causal attribution
Original model and tests may have been shaped by review findings; report initial vs repaired states
Updated skill deliberately contains lessons from old defects; those are learned regression cases, not unseen holdouts
parent_interventions: Record corrections separately; freeze numerical suite before exposing common candidates; do not repair detection gaps before reporting.
